Frequently Asked Questions

Most frequent questions and answers about our children's Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu program in valley ranch - coppell.

Will My Child Become A Bully?

Our valley ranch - coppell kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu training builds humility, confidence, and respect in children. These traits turn kids into the opposite of bullies. They become leaders.

Do Parents Need To Stay?

You're welcome to stay and watch every class, or drop off and run errands – whatever works for your family. Many parents relax in our lobby while their child trains.

What Do I Need To Bring To My First Lesson?

Just comfortable clothes your child can move in, water, and a smile. We'll provide everything else they need to get started.

My Child Has ADD/ADHD, Will Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Help?

Many of our parents tell us the structure, physical activity, and focus games in class help their child channel their energy and concentrate better, both on and off the mats.

Are Parents Allowed To Watch?

Absolutely. Our lobby has a clear view of the mats, so you can watch every class and cheer your child on.

My Child Is Not Athletic, Will They Feel Left Out?

Not at all. Every class is coached to each child's own pace and ability. Most of our kids started out exactly where your child is now, and they progress at their own speed.

My Child Is Addicted To Video Games, Will This Be Suitable?

Yes. Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gives kids the same sense of levels, goals, and achievement they love in games – except it builds real confidence, fitness, and friendships along the way.

What's Different About Different Martial Arts Styles?

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu focuses on close-range control and grappling, teaching kids how to stay safe without relying on strikes. Other styles like Muay Thai focus more on striking. Both build discipline, fitness, and self-defense skill in different ways.
